items.stem: 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: gather – collect
harm – hurt
heal – cure
waste – save
path – way
items.explain: ④는 반의어(낭비하다 – 절약하다), 나머지는 유의어.

items.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어느 곳에도 들어갈 수 없는 표현은?
items.box:
B: Hey, Jina. ⓐ______?
G: I'm deleting my emails.
B: Why?
G: ⓑ______ storing emails uses a lot of energy.
B: Really?
G: Yeah, using too much energy is bad for the Earth.
B: Oh, ⓒ______. I'll delete my emails, too.
G: And ⓓ______ block spam and ads.
choices: What are you doing
I heard that
I get it
you should also
I hope you get better soon
items.explain: ⓐ What are you doing ⓑ I heard that ⓒ I get it ⓓ you should also. ⑤는 문맥에 맞는 자리가 없다.

items.stem: 아래 (A)~(C)를 대화의 흐름에 맞게 순서대로 배열한 것은?
items.box:
G: What do you want to be when you grow up?
B: I want to be a pet trainer.
(A) That's so cool! Why don't you teach my dog some skills, too?
(B) A pet trainer?
(C) Yes, I'm interested in training pets. I often teach my dogs skills at home.
B: I'd love to!
items.explain: 되묻기(B) → 관심 설명(C) → 제안(A) → 수락.

items.box:
G: Hi, my name is Emma. I watch your channel every day!
W: Hi, Emma. Thank you so much.
G: I want (A)[become / to become] a content creator like you.
W: Great! What kind of content do you want to make?
G: I'm interested (B)[in / at] e-sports, travel, and K-pop.
W: Those are great topics! Start with short videos.
G: Thank you for the advice. I'll give it a try.
W: I hope you (C)[enjoy / enjoying] (D)[creating / to create] content.

items.stem: (A)~(D)에 들어갈 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: want + to부정사 / be interested in / hope (that) you enjoy / enjoy + 동명사.
items.source: L5 Listen & Speak B · 학습지 Dictation

items.stem: 위 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
choices: How often does Emma watch the channel?
What does Emma want to become?
What is Emma interested in?
How long has the woman run her channel?
What does the woman advise Emma to do?
items.explain: 채널을 운영한 기간은 나오지 않는다.

items.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 위 대화에서 찾을 수 없는 것은?
choices: things like videos, pictures, or posts that people make and share online
the main idea that people talk or write about
an opinion you give someone about what they should do
to make something new or original
to do something again and again to get better at it
items.explain: ① content ② topic ③ advice ④ create(creating) ⑤ practice — 대화에 없다.

items.stem: 다음 두 문장을 가주어 It을 이용해 주어진 해석에 맞고 어법상 바르게 영작한 것은?
items.box:
우리가 함께 공부하는 것은 중요하다.
• It is important.  • We study together.
choices: It is important for we to study together.
It is important of us to study together.
It is important for us to study together.
It is important for us studying together.
That is important for us to study together.
items.explain: 가주어 It + 형용사 + for 목적격 + to부정사. important 는 for 를 쓴다.

items.box:
Why Do We Work?
First, we work (A)<u>to make</u> money. Our jobs help us get paid so we can make a living. Second, we work (B)<u>to take on</u> social roles. For example, street cleaners keep our towns and cities clean, and police officers make our society safe. We rely on others to do these important jobs, and everyone has a special role (C)<u>to play</u>. Third, we work (D)<u>to feel</u> proud of our work. By working, we can help others and show our abilities. In the end, we work (E)<u>to find</u> meaning in life.

items.stem: 윗글의 (A)~(E) to부정사 중, 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
items.explain: (C)는 명사 role 을 꾸미는 형용사적 용법, 나머지는 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: 우리는 생계를 유지하기 위해 일한다.
경찰관은 우리 사회를 안전하게 만든다.
모든 사람에게는 맡은 특별한 역할이 있다.
일을 통해 우리의 능력을 보여 줄 수 있다.
사람들은 결국 돈을 벌기 위해서만 일한다.
items.explain: 결국 우리는 삶의 의미를 찾기 위해 일한다.

items.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 윗글에서 찾을 수 있는 것의 개수는?
items.box:
• the power or skill to do something

• feeling pleased and satisfied about something that you have done
• to travel to or around an area in order to learn about it

choices: 3개
4개
5개
6개
7개
items.explain: ability(abilities)·society·role·proud·job(jobs) 5개. explore·topic 은 없다.

items.box:
Date & Time: October 2, 10:00 a.m.
I have thought about how to help corals.
(A) Many corals get sick because they don't get good care in time.
(B) My plan is to form a team of divers.
(C) I'm sure that other divers are worried about this, too.
(D) My team can go underwater and take care of the sick corals.
(E) I'm going to post a message online to look for (가)<u>volunteer</u> divers.

items.stem: 윗글의 흐름에 맞게 (A)~(E)를 순서대로 배열할 때, ★에 들어갈 것으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: (B) 계획 → (D) 팀이 할 일 → (A) 산호가 아픈 까닭 → (C) 다른 잠수부들도 걱정 → (E) 메시지 게시. ★은 (A).

items.stem: 윗글의 (가)volunteer의 영영풀이로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: someone who does something without being paid or forced to do it
a doctor for animals
a person who makes decisions in court
a person who makes films, music, etc.
a person who helps by listening and talking
items.explain: volunteer 자원봉사자. ② vet ③ judge ④ producer ⑤ counselor.

items.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: It is easy ______ her to learn new languages.
It is difficult ______ us to solve the problem.
It was brave ______ her to stand up for her friend.
It is important ______ him to finish the project.
It is not easy ______ you to find a future job.
items.explain: 성격·태도 형용사(brave)는 of + 목적격, 나머지는 for + 목적격.
items.source: 학습지 L5 Grammar Point A · L5 본문

items.stem: 다음 두 문장을 현재완료를 이용해 한 문장으로 어법상 바르게 바꾼 것은?
choices:
Spring came, and it is spring now.
→ Spring has come.

Eddie lost his cap, and he still can't find it.
→ Eddie has lose his cap.

My parents went to Hong Kong, and they are still there.
→ My parents have been to Hong Kong.

I started to wear glasses in 2024, and I still wear them.
→ I have worn glasses for 2024.

He joined the reading club two years ago, and he is still in it.
→ He has be in the reading club for two years.
items.explain: ② has lost ③ have gone to(결과) ④ since 2024 ⑤ has been.
items.source: 통합본 L6 문법 C · 학습지 Grammar Point A

items.box: Corals are very important (   ) our oceans. Many sea animals live (   ) them. Corals also keep sea animals safe (   ) big waves and storms. They are like walls. Corals clean the air, too. They take (   ) greenhouse gases (   ) the water. This helps reduce these gases in the ocean and the air.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
choices: for
near
from
in
of
items.explain: important for / live near / safe from / take in / from the water.

items.stem: 윗글을 다음과 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
items.box: Corals give many sea animals a ⓐ______ and ⓑ______ them from big waves. They also help ⓒ______ greenhouse gases in the ocean and the air.
items.explain: 많은 바다 동물이 산호 근처에 살고(home), 파도로부터 지켜 주며(protect), 온실가스를 줄이는(reduce) 데 도움을 준다.

items.stem: 다음 우리말을 주어진 단어를 모두 한 번씩 사용해 영작할 때, 아홉 번째에 오는 단어는?
items.box:
그것들을 실제 직업과 연결해 보라, 그러면 여러분의 길을 찾을 것이다.
→ (them, to, job, try, connect, a, real, and, you, find, will, your, path, to)
(*단, 대소문자는 구분하지 않음.)
choices: them
to
and
will
job
items.explain: Try to connect them to a real job, and you will find your path. 아홉 번째는 and.

items.stem: 현재완료의 의문문·부정문으로 어법상 바르게 변형한 것은?
choices:
He has done his homework.
→ Has he done his homework?

She has visited Seoul.
→ Does she has visited Seoul?

They have finished the meeting.
→ They have finished not the meeting.

I have seen her before.
→ I have not seen her never before.

The bus has just arrived.
→ Has just the bus arrived?
items.explain: ② Has she visited ③ have not finished ④ have never seen ⑤ Has the bus just arrived.

items.box:
How Can I Find My Job?
Everyone has their own favorite activities. Try to connect them to a real job, and you will find your path. (A)<u>만약 여러분이 TV 프로그램 보는 것을 좋아한다면, 여러분은 그 프로그램의 프로듀서나 작가가 될 수 있다.</u> However, liking something and ⓐ<u>being</u> good at it are not the same. Playing soccer as a job ⓑ<u>are</u> different from playing it as a hobby. You love soccer but aren't good at it. Then you can look for other jobs in soccer. If you are good at ⓒ<u>taking</u> care of people, you can become a soccer player's manager. Or you can work as a marketer for a soccer team if you are good at ⓓ<u>think</u> creatively. Look for jobs ⓔ<u>who</u> match your favorite things and your abilities.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)를 바르게 영작한 문장은?
choices: If you like watching TV shows, you can be a producer or a writer for those shows.
If you like to watching TV shows, you can be a producer or a writer for those shows.
If you will like watching TV shows, you can be a producer or a writer for those shows.
If you like watching TV shows, you can be a producer and a writer for those shows.
If you like watching TV shows, you can be a producer or a writer for that shows.
items.explain: ② to watching ✗ ③ 조건절에 will ✗ ④ and → or ⑤ that shows → those shows.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
items.explain: ⓑ 동명사구 주어는 단수 → is, ⓓ 전치사 뒤 → thinking, ⓔ 선행사 jobs → that/which.

items.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 알맞은 것은?
choices: ways to become a famous soccer player
the importance of studying school subjects
how to find a job that matches your interests and abilities
why liking something is enough to get a job
how to enjoy soccer as a hobby
items.explain: 좋아하는 것과 능력에 맞는 직업을 찾는 방법.

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
choices: What should you do if you love soccer but aren't good at it?
What job can you get if you are good at taking care of people?
What kind of person can work as a marketer for a soccer team?
How many jobs are there in soccer?
What should you look for?
items.explain: 축구 관련 직업의 수는 나오지 않는다.

items.box:
Date & Time: November 7, 9:40 p.m.
For the last two weeks, my team (A)<u>has put</u> ointment on sick corals. We also took some healthy baby corals from the sea and put them in tanks of seawater. We feed them clam parts and seaweed smoothies. This food helps baby corals grow stronger. When they are ready, we'll plant them onto the corals in the sea. Our goal is to grow many   (가)   corals. I look forward to seeing the results!
Date & Time: November 27, 11:30 a.m.
Last night, some   (가)   corals in the sea laid eggs during the full moon. This morning, hundreds of baby corals ⓐ<u>were born</u> from the eggs like magic. They were cute and ⓑ<u>amazed</u>. I hope this miracle ⓒ<u>will happen</u> to other sick corals, too. Although it ⓓ<u>took</u> time to heal the sick corals and grow   (가)   ones, it was worth ⓔ<u>the hard work</u>.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 (가)에 공통으로 들어갈 단어가 아래 ①~⑤의 빈칸에 사용되었을 때, 문맥상 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: Eating vegetables every day keeps you (     ).
The (     ) weather made us stay at home.
He was too (     ) to open the door.
She felt (     ) about the bad news.

items.explain: (가) healthy. 채소를 먹는 것은 건강하게 유지해 준다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)has put과 현재완료의 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: I have lost my wallet.
She has just finished her homework.
Have you ever baked bread?
I have lived in Sydney since 2022.
Dan has never been to Canada before.
items.explain: For the last two weeks ~ 계속 용법. ① 결과 ② 완료 ③ 경험 ⑤ 경험.
items.source: L6 본문 · 통합본 L6 문법 B

items.stem: 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
items.explain: 산호가 (남을) 놀라게 하는 것이므로 amazing. amazed 는 스스로 놀란 감정.
items.source: L6 본문 · 학습지 p109 필기(amazing vs amazed)

items.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 윗글에서 찾을 수 없는 것은?
choices: a soft cream used on the skin to treat a medical problem
a container for holding liquid or gas
a plant that grows in the sea
to produce eggs outside the body
to process waste so that it can be used again
items.explain: ① ointment ② tank ③ seaweed ④ lay(laid) ⑤ recycle — 글에 없다.

items.stem: 다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
items.box:
A: I'm interested in playing sports and fixing machines.
B: Are you Type R?
A: Yes. Pilots, engineers, police officers, and sports players are often Type R.
B: Which of those jobs do you like?
A: I'm interested in jobs like pilot or engineer.
B: I hope you find your dream job soon.
choices: A is interested in playing sports.
A is Type R.
Pilots and engineers are often Type R.
A is interested in jobs like police officer.
B hopes A finds a dream job soon.
items.explain: A 는 조종사나 엔지니어 같은 직업에 관심이 있다.

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
It is important for you to be careful all the time.
It was careless for him to forget his passport.
Hurry up, or you will be late for school.
Wearing a helmet, and you can protect your head.
I have known him since 2024.
He has won the prize last year.
Although it was raining, we went outside.
Despite the weather was bad, they went hiking.
choices: 2개
3개
4개
5개
6개
items.explain: 옳은 것: 1·3·5·7. careless of him / Wear a helmet, and / won the prize last year(과거) / Although the weather was bad.
items.source: 학습지 L5·L6 Grammar Point · 통합본 문법
